title: flagged content hides itself, and the poster is told why

criteria.text: Everything a member posts is reportable; a report triggers agent classification
criteria.note: Reportable: Page photo, Page picture, announcement, post photo (`reports.subject_kind`, migration 20261007290000). AI reads in shadow mode (#513). Missing: a Page's own words and listings have no report path [V] Checked: unmarked: `PagePosts.test.tsx`, `create.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Hides when score is at or above the metro's bar, by the agent
criteria.note: `metro_polygons.hide_bar` exists. No score reaches the bar: `create.ts` "No classifier yet"; `ai_mode` defaults `shadow` [V]. No effect at bar 0 Checked: partial (`[guards F078.2 partial]`, posts-reportable-db).

criteria.text: Poster told in-app, never email, with category, reporter's reason and a plain explanation
criteria.note: `member_notices` row written in the hide transaction; `YouNotices`. Sensitive-content reports skip the notice (DECISIONS 2026-10-06, NCMEC) [V] Checked: partial only.

criteria.text: Poster submits one explanation; unanswered takedown stays hidden and closes itself
criteria.note: `report.answer`, one per hide, 14-day window (F102) [V]. "Only an answer creates work" not asserted Checked: partial only (F102.3, F102.4).

criteria.text: Threat of harm / children texts Don at once; rest queues in a mobile review view
criteria.note: `operator-sms.ts` via Twilio after commit; review page (#380). Whether `TWILIO_*` / `OPERATOR_PHONE` are set in production: unknown Checked: unmarked: `operator-sms.test.ts`, `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Below the bar nothing automatic; lands in the same queue; at launch nothing is below
criteria.note: A report is always stored and queued; hide gated on `reachesBar` [V] Checked: partial (`create.test.ts`).

criteria.text: Bar is per-metro data, no migration or deploy; starts at 0; unresolvable metro uses 0
criteria.note: `BAR_OF_LOCATION` coalesces to 0, min() on overlap [V] Checked: partial (create.test.ts, member-notices-db).

criteria.text: Children / threat-of-harm hide at any bar
criteria.note: `URGENT_CATEGORIES` bypass bar, limits and strikes [V] Checked: yes (`create.test.ts` `[guards F078.8]`).

criteria.text: No report without a reporter-chosen reason
criteria.note: Handler and sheet both refuse [V] Checked: yes (`create.test.ts`, `ReportControl.test.tsx`).

criteria.text: Reporter told before sending: misuse is a strike, three stops hiding
criteria.note: `COPY` line on the sheet; strikes counted at report time (#488 lane) [V] Checked: yes (`create.test.ts` `[guards F078.10]`).

criteria.text: Every string kind and gracious; wording is Don's
criteria.note: All strings are placeholders (`copy.ts`, `notices.ts`, `categories.ts`); not worded by Don [V]
